title: highlights-agent answer
description:
The agent's structured reply. Every golden case asserts against this schema first, before any judge runs.

The structure is doing real work: `cited_titles` makes groundedness a deterministic check (a title id absent from the catalog is a confabulation — no judge needed), and `entitlement` records whether the answer came from the entitlement-check tool or from the model guessing. CLAUDE.md prefers a deterministic assertion wherever one can express the requirement; this schema is where that preference is cashed in.

answer.description: Prose shown to the viewer. `must_mention` / `must_not_claim` asserts run against this field only.

cited_titles.description: Catalog ids this answer relies on. Every id must exist in the fixture catalog — that assertion IS the groundedness check.

entitlement.description: Null when the question did not concern access. Non-null answers must be sourced from entitlement-check, not inferred — `source` is what the M06 trajectory eval reads.

source.description: `model-inference` is what the ungoverned control emits. It is a legal value precisely so the baseline can be scored honestly rather than crashing the harness (SPEC/00b).

ai_disclosure.description: Disclosure text required by MER-AI-0001 on AI-authored editorial copy. Null until M07 disposes that rule.
